steps.observation: You have 900 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three key causes of World War I were:

• The complex system of military alliances (e.g., Triple Alliance vs. Triple Entente) that turned regional disputes into a wider conflict.  
• Widespread militarism and an escalating arms race among the great powers of Europe.  
• Intense nationalism—most explosively seen in the Balkans—which culminated in the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria‐Hungary in 1914.
